title: Dharahara
visualBrief: Standing rebuilt Dharahara: pale tapered circular shaft with eight molded collars/sparse circular oculi, actual recessed arched base entrance/closed dark door, projecting molded observation deck/open balustrade, shallow domed lantern and slender finial. Separate mapped stepped old base, irregular broken brick/plaster stump under an open-framed translucent pyramidal shelter. Original simple trim/rail/radial support vocabulary, shared textures and four browser levels. No reconstruction of the destroyed full historical tower, copied inscription/photo atlas, furnished interior, underground museum, broad precinct plaza or temporary lights/visitors.

sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Use the two inspected2026 picture captions as nominal72m current rebuilt tower height, including top finial; this is not a survey.
